seg.notes: Segment revenues include freight, delivery & transportation revenues (Aggregates footnote), so seg.delivery_rev is null (not shown separately in the segment table; consolidated freight & delivery revenues are in is.delivery_rev). Only Aggregates has intersegment sales. Calcium segment = calcium products (Florida). Asphalt/Concrete cash GP not published in release (null).

is.notes: Pre-2018 presentation: income statement shows only 'Total revenues' (freight & delivery revenues included). is.delivery_rev = 'Freight and delivery revenues' and is.net_sales = 'Total revenues excluding freight and delivery revenues' from the release's non-GAAP gross-margin reconciliation (published figures, not computed). No noncontrolling interest (nci = 0). dps = cash dividends per share as shown in the release/10-Q statement of earnings.

ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). Q4 three-month column taken directly from the Q4-17 release (not derived). Bridge 'Diluted EPS' = diluted EPS from continuing operations. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act: Q4-17 tax benefit $313.6m includes $268m net benefit from deferred-tax remeasurement/other TCJA effects ($1.99/sh 'Tax reform income tax savings') and $29m partial release of Alabama NOL valuation allowance ($0.21/sh); combined ~$297m / $2.20/sh removed from Adjusted EPS (eps_discrete_tax_ps). eps_items_after_tax_ps = 0.02 EBITDA items + 0.49 after-tax interest charges on early debt retirement (pretax $102m in interest expense). 'One time employee bonuses' (tax-reform related) and 'Property donation' (charitable) mapped to adj_items.other.
